naxp 0.0.0.9000
  • R index
Implements naxp, the standard encoding of ASCII text as unsigned integers <https://naxp.org/spec/>. A naxp is written in a syntax like that of regular expressions. It encodes each text it accepts, such as a postcode, as an integer from 1 to a fixed maximum, and decodes each integer back to a canonical form of the text. Wraps the naxp 'C++' library.
